arxiv-2012-11957.title: Generalized Relation Learning with Semantic Correlation Awareness for Link Prediction
arxiv-2012-11957.creator: Yao Zhang, Xu Zhang, Jun Wang, Hongru Liang, Wenqiang Lei, Zhe Sun, Adam Jatowt, Zhenglu Yang
arxiv-2012-11957.description: Abstract Developing link prediction models to automatically complete knowledge graphs has recently been the focus of significant research interest. The current methods for the link prediction task have two natural problems: 1) the relation distributions in KGs are usually unbalanced, and 2) there are many unseen relations that occur in practical situations.

arxiv-2103-09128.title: Cascade of singularities in the spin dynamics of a perturbed quantum critical Ising chain
arxiv-2103-09128.creator: Xiao Wang, Haiyuan Zou, Kristóf Hódsági, Márton Kormos, Gábor Takács, Jianda Wu
arxiv-2103-09128.description: A 2021 arXiv research paper by Xiao Wang, Haiyuan Zou, Kristóf Hódsági, Márton Kormos, Gábor Takács, Jianda Wu. When the quantum critical transverse-field Ising chain is perturbed by a longitudinal field, a quantum integrable model emerges in the scaling limit with massive excitations described by the exceptional E 8 E_{8} Lie algebra.

arxiv-2109-14263.title: Cooperative Task Offloading and Block Mining in Blockchain-based Edge Computing with Multi-agent Deep Reinforcement Learning Thanks: Dinh C. Nguyen and Pubudu N. Pathirana are with School of Engineering, Deakin University, Waurn Ponds, VIC 3216, Australia (e-mails: {cdnguyen, pubudu.pathirana}@deaki
arxiv-2109-14263.creator: Dinh C. Nguyen, Ming Ding, Pubudu N. Pathirana, Aruna Seneviratne, Jun Li
arxiv-2109-14263.description: Abstract The convergence of mobile edge computing (MEC) and blockchain is transforming the current computing services in mobile networks, by offering task offloading solutions with security enhancement empowered by blockchain mining. Nevertheless, these important enabling technologies have been studied separately in most existing works.

arxiv-2305-13439.title: Observation of four top quark production in proton-proton collisions at s = 13 ​ \TeV \sqrt{s}=13\TeV
arxiv-2305-13439.description: Abstract The observation of the production of four top quarks in proton-proton collisions is reported, based on a data sample collected by the CMS experiment at a center-of-mass energy of 13 \TeV in 2016–2018 at the CERN LHC and corresponding to an integrated luminosity of 138 \fbinv .

arxiv-2306-05673.title: Characterization of a 220 Rn source for low-energy electronic recoil calibration of the XENONnT detector
arxiv-2306-05673.creator: Rafael F. Lang
arxiv-2306-05673.description: Abstract Low-background liquid xenon detectors are utilized in the investigation of rare events, including dark matter and neutrinoless double beta decay. For their calibration, gaseous 220 Rn can be used. After being introduced into the xenon, its progeny isotope 212 Pb induces homogeneously distributed, low-energy ( < 30 <30 keV) electronic recoil interactions.

arxiv-2507-20468.title: Building crypto portfolios with agentic AI
arxiv-2507-20468.creator: Antonino Castelli, Paolo Giudici, Alessandro Piergallini
arxiv-2507-20468.description: Abstract The rapid growth of crypto markets has opened new opportunities for investors, but at the same time exposed them to high volatility. To address the challenge of managing dynamic portfolios in such an environment, this paper presents a practical application of a multi-agent system designed to autonomously construct and evaluate crypto-asset allocations.

Recovering world-coordinate human motion from monocular videos with humanoid robot retargeting is significant for embodied intelligence and robotics. pmc-10507642.title: Paradoxical psoriasis: The flip side of idiopathic psoriasis or an autocephalous reversible drug reaction?
pmc-10507642.creator: Jiawei Lu, Yan Lu
pmc-10507642.description: Psoriasis is a common, chronic skin disease that results mainly from the complex interplay between T cells, dendritic cells, and inflammatory cytokines including TNF-α, IL-17, IL-12, and IL-23. Successful therapy with anti-cytokine antibodies has proved the importance of these key cytokines, especially TNF-α. During the anti-TNF-α treatment of classical idiopathic psoriasis, a small portion of patients develop new psoriasiform lesions.

pmc-10628356.title: Lyme rashes disease classification using deep feature fusion technique
pmc-10628356.creator: Ghulam Ali, Muhammad Anwar, Muhammad Nauman, Muhammad Faheem, Javed Rashid
pmc-10628356.description: Automatic classification of Lyme disease rashes on the skin helps clinicians and dermatologists’ probe and investigate Lyme skin rashes effectively. This paper proposes a new in‐depth features fusion system to classify Lyme disease rashes. The proposed method consists of two main steps.

pmc-11348248.title: Why Are Healthcare Providers Leaving Their Jobs? A Convergent Mixed-Methods Investigation of Turnover Intention among Canadian Healthcare Providers during the COVID-19 Pandemic
pmc-11348248.creator: Andrea M D’Alessandro-Lowe, Andrea Brown, Emily Sullo, Mina Pichtikova, Mauda Karram, James Mirabelli, Randi E McCabe, Margaret C McKinnon, Kim Ritchie, Richard Gray
pmc-11348248.description: Background: Staffing shortages across the healthcare sector pose a threat to the continuity of the Canadian healthcare system in the post-COVID-19 pandemic era. We sought to understand factors associated with turnover intention as well as Canadian healthcare providers’ (HCPs) perspectives and experiences with turnover intention as related to both organizational and professional turnover.

pmc-11465266.title: Preparation of Baicalin Liposomes Using Microfluidic Technology and Evaluation of Their Antitumor Activity by a Zebrafish Model
pmc-11465266.creator: Yuhao Gu, Liqiang Jin, Li Wang, Xianzheng Ma, Mingfa Tian, Ammara Sohail, Jianchun Wang, Daijie Wang
pmc-11465266.description: Baicalin (BCL), a well-known flavonoid molecule, has numerous therapeutic applications. However, its low water solubility and bioavailability limit its applicability. Microfluidics is a new method for liposome preparation that provides efficient and rapid control of the process, improving the stability and controllability.

pmc-12452722.title: Challenges in the Diagnosis and Management of Triosephosphate Isomerase Deficiency: A Case Report
pmc-12452722.creator: Carolina Ramos, Inês Pereira, Joana Coelho, Patrícia Dias, Patrícia Lipari Pinto, Anabela Ferrão, Rosário Ferreira, Toshio Hattori
pmc-12452722.description: Background and Clinical Significance: Triosephosphate isomerase (TPI) deficiency is a rare autosomal recessive metabolic disorder caused by a pathogenic variant in the TPI1 gene. It is characterised by chronic haemolytic anaemia, progressive neuromuscular dysfunction, and reduced life expectancy. Patients typically present with symptoms in the first few months of life, including muscle weakness, ataxia, and recurrent respiratory infections.

pmc-12732981.title: Modulating Whiteleg Shrimp (Penaeus vannamei) Health from the Inside out: Effects of Xylooligosaccharides from Salicornia ramosissima on Gut Metabolites and Microbial Community
pmc-12732981.creator: Ana Garcia, Sergio Fernández-Boo, André Barreto, Miguel Semedo, Mette Hedegaard Thomsen, Allan Stensballe, Maxwel Monção, Leonidas Matsakas, Paul Christakopoulos, Viswanath Kiron, Rui J M Rocha, Benjamin Costas, Terence L Marsh
pmc-12732981.description: Whiteleg shrimp (Penaeus vannamei) is currently facing significant challenges related to severe disease outbreaks. As the importance of the host–microbiota relationship is being revealed, modulating this relationship has become a key strategy in disease management. Xylooligosaccharides (XOS)—short-chain sugar molecules—have been gaining attention for their potential health benefits in the prebiotics field.

pmc-13458310.title: ADP‐ribosylation: An emerging regulator of the epigenome
pmc-13458310.creator: Cristel V. Camacho, Chenqian Liu, W. Lee Kraus
pmc-13458310.description: ADP‐ribosylation (ADPRylation) is a post‐translational modification best known for its roles in DNA damage responses and cytoplasmic signaling, but it also serves important functions in epigenome regulation. In the nucleus, ADPRylation modulates chromatin structure and gene expression through the coordinated modification of histones and chromatin‐associated proteins.
